sources.title: Specification for Monthly Tax Deduction (MTD) Using Computerised Calculation, year 2026
sources.note: Official PDF retrieved 2026-08-08 (HTTP 200, 1375535 bytes). Formula authority for offline Normal Remuneration compute (MY-STAT-S07b). EXHIBIT 5 worked examples are the first Normal vector suite. Local evidence: db/evidence/pcb-spec-2026.pdf (sha256 re-verified on download, byte-identical). Table 1 (p.9), Table 2/REP (p.15), Table 3/Knowledge Worker (p.16), and Table 4/C-Suite (p.18) all read directly from this file and cross-checked against src/domain/calc/pcb-tables.ts and pcb-core.ts's flat15RebateTSen — Table 2 and Table 3 are confirmed byte-for-byte identical in the primary source, not merely assumed.
